items.name: Chest Hunt
items.description: Pry open a chest, appraise what is inside, and count the gold — the chest is cursed, and it takes its toll.
items.template: You pry open a chest and find [Chest]. The appraiser calls it {ChestAppraisal}. You also find ((5-30)) gold coins. The chest seems to be cursed, though: opening it drains a bit of your essence, and you take |thunderclap| damage.
